## 💎 Premium Moroccan Raw Materials

### 1. [Lead (Pb)](https://www.the-3rocks.com/products/lead)
- **Description:** Soft, highly malleable, corrosion-resistant, and high-density lead ore and concentrates.
- **Grades & Purities:**
  - Lead Concentrate: **86% pure**
  - Lead Powder: **76% pure**
  - Raw Lead Ore: **>50% pure**
- **Sourcing Regions:** Errachidia and Bni Taddjit, Morocco.
- **Common Applications:** Batteries, radiation shielding, construction, soundproofing, and electronics.

### 2. [Zinc (Zn)](https://www.the-3rocks.com/products/zinc)
- **Description:** Premium quality zinc calamine ore and zinc concentrates.
- **Grades & Purities:**
  - Zinc Concentrate: **70% purity**
  - Zinc Calamine Ore: **+37% purity**
- **Common Applications:** Steel galvanization, die-casting, pharmaceutical compounds, and cosmetics.

### 3. [Copper (Cu)](https://www.the-3rocks.com/products/copper)
- **Description:** Superior-grade copper ores and concentrates powering modern infrastructure.
- **Grades & Purities:**
  - Standard Ore Purity: **8% to 21%**
  - High-Purity Ore: **Up to 40%** (available via special export permit)
- **Common Applications:** Electrical wiring, power transmission, telecommunications, and heat exchangers.

### 4. [Barite (BaSO4)](https://www.the-3rocks.com/products/barite)
- **Description:** High-density barium sulfate (barytine) meeting API drilling standards.
- **Specific Gravity / Density:** **4.18 - 4.28**
- **Common Applications:** Oil and gas drilling fluids, medical shielding, paint fillers, and industrial coatings.

### 5. [Iron (Fe)](https://www.the-3rocks.com/products/iron)
- **Description:** Premium-grade hematite and magnetite iron ores.
- **Grades & Purities:**
  - Iron Ore: **≥ 56% purity**
- **Common Applications:** Construction, steel manufacturing, automotive, and heavy industrial machinery.

### 6. [Cobalt (Co)](https://www.the-3rocks.com/products/cobalt)
- **Description:** Battery-grade cobalt ores and concentrates essential for advanced electronics.
- **Grades & Purities:**
  - Cobalt Concentrate: **42%+ purity**
- **Common Applications:** EV batteries, superalloys for aerospace, magnets, and medical technologies.

### 7. [Antimony (Sb)](https://www.the-3rocks.com/products/antimony)
- **Description:** Critical metalloid raw material for advanced technologies.
- **Grades & Purities:**
  - Antimony Ore/Concentrate: **30%+ purity**
- **Common Applications:** Halogen-free flame retardants, lead alloys, glass/ceramics, and semiconductors.

Detailed educational and industry resources written by The 3 Rocks geological and supply-chain experts:

  - [Morocco Lead Mining](https://www.the-3rocks.com/articles/morocco-lead-mining): Structural guide to lead veins in Bni Taddjit.
  - [Moroccan Copper Mining](https://www.the-3rocks.com/articles/moroccan-copper-mining): Exploring Tinghir and related copper deposits.

  - [Moroccan Cobalt](https://www.the-3rocks.com/articles/moroccan-cobalt): North Africa's contribution to clean energy materials.
